rule.statement: The Appellant is not entitled to be noticed in terms of section 20(1) of the Partition Law.
rule.supporting_quote: Notice in terms of these provisions should be sent only to claimants mentioned in the report of the surveyor or to a person disclosed by a defendant under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) of section 19. However, neither of the two surveyor reports (P3B) (P4B) mentions the Appellant as a claimant to the land surveyed. Furthermore, none of the defendants have disclosed the Appellant under paragraph (c) of subsection (1) of Section 19.
